name: Unofficial Traditional Chinese Patch
author: Community
description: Unofficial Traditional Chinese patch for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition. Fixes font size/weight, subtitle artifacts, and applies text corrections to Engine.ucs.

files.name: setup_relic_tool.ps1
files.description: Install virtual environment and SGA manipulation tools

files.name: unpack_chinese_locale.ps1
files.description: Extract EnginLoc.sga archive to data/ folder with auto-backup

files.name: apply_font_fix.py
files.description: Main patching script for .fnt font configuration files

files.name: repack_chinese_locale.ps1
files.description: Optional: repack modified data/ folder into new .sga archive

files.name: FONT_FIX_README.md
files.description: Technical documentation and original research notes

usage.quickStart: Run setup_relic_tool.ps1, then unpack_chinese_locale.ps1, then apply_font_fix.py with default options (size 34, mode fallback-only)
usage.advancedOptions: See README.md for font size tuning, --mode all option, and Microsoft YaHei replacement

1.0.0: Dry-run mode for preview before applying

notes.installation: Extract to Engine/Locale/Chinese folder in your DoW:DE installation. No repack needed—game loads unpacked data/ folder directly.
notes.backups: Original .sga backed up automatically in backup/ folder. Each .fnt gets a .bak backup.
notes.performance: No runtime performance impact—all fixes are applied offline to .fnt files.
notes.compatibility: No conflicts with other mods. Works with any gameplay/cosmetic mods.
